assets.prompt: The supplied ensemble revision is rejected only because its outer incidental people touch the final crop edges. Make a compact crop-safe revision while preserving the canonical trio's supplied original faces, clothes, accessories, relative heights, the six generic Ambient Life treatments, and the same restrained locked-B watercolor/colored-pencil style. Move every incidental person inward by at least one full body width and scale the whole ensemble down slightly. The outer 25 percent of the canvas on both left and right must be entirely untouched soft-ivory paper with absolutely no figure, garment, shoe, bag, shadow, pigment, or line. All nine people must be fully contained between 25 and 75 percent of canvas width, with visible ivory breathing room between the outermost person and those blank bands. Arrange compactly in depth: the three canonical leads centered and largest on a shared baseline; three much smaller anonymous ambient figures grouped behind and to their left; three much smaller anonymous ambient figures grouped behind and to their right. Do not stretch the ambient line toward either canvas edge. Canonical scale remains clear: Zhou An tallest with wavy dark hair, thin rectangular glasses, rolled navy shirt, sand overalls and rolled leather tool wrap; silver-haired Lin Deng moderately tall with a gentle stoop, no glasses, cream shirt, brown waistcoat, navy coat and brass pocket watch; short-bobbed A-Yao shortest with rust-red scarf, olive field jacket, indigo trousers and worn canvas satchel. Exactly six generic low-detail incidental people, varied walking, pausing, carrying and conversational gestures; warm-gray, sage, faded ochre and dusty-blue silhouettes; never copies of the leads. One uninterrupted ivory paper field. Delicate locked-B watercolor washes, restrained pigment, fine warm-gray-brown linework on leads, colored-pencil texture, subtle paper grain. Wholly original, no actor, real-person, film, TV, or existing-character resemblance. No cats or animals, no text, no labels, no marks, no logo, no signature, no watermark, no UI, no panel, no border, no frame, no clipping, no cropped figure, no photorealism, no 3D, no heavy black outline, no saturated color.
